entradas.idea: Nora normal y realista, sin dramatismo, en los lugares más bellos de una ciudad city pop, luz cálida y neones

<Picture 1>.ficha: white short-sleeve school shirt, navy plaid skirt, school bag

<Picture 2>.atuendo: black leather jacket and round glasses
<Picture 2>.ficha: black leather jacket over a dark red ribbed sweater, beige trench coat, round glasses

<Picture 3>.ficha: plain white shirt with an open collar

<Picture 4>.ficha: plain white shirt with an open collar, sunset light

<Picture 5>.ficha: a girl waving with one arm raised high, caught mid-step on a night crosswalk

<Picture 6>.ficha: a girl standing on a night train platform with her hands in her pockets, blowing a small pink bubble-gum bubble

<Picture 7>.ficha: a girl in profile, looking down at the phone she holds at chest height

<Picture 8>.ficha: a girl sitting on a railing, leaning toward the camera, with a lollipop in her mouth

<Picture 9>.ficha: a girl with one hand on her chest and the other arm open, calmly enjoying the rain

E1.ficha: hand-drawn white and colored doodles drawn around <Subject 1>: little stars, hearts, swirls and sparkle marks

E2.ficha: the image turns black and white except <Subject 1>'s face, which stays in full color inside a tilted rectangular selection box with small blue corner handles, like a photo-editing app

E3.nombre: recorte de pegatina con papel rasgado
E3.ficha: <Subject 1> appears cut out with a thick rough white sticker edge, in front of a huge torn paper shape in a bold color, with a few dry-brush strokes

E4.ficha: the image turns into a film snapshot with a white instant-photo border and slight chromatic aberration

E5.nombre: luz de móvil y círculos de luz de la ciudad
E5.ficha: her face lit only by the cold blue glow of a phone screen, the night city melting into huge flat painted golden and cyan light circles around her

E6.ficha: little colorful star sparkles in pink, blue, yellow and green and snowflakes floating right in front of her face, flash-photo look

E7.ficha: rain streaks crossing in front of her face under a gray-violet stormy light

entradas.estilo: Flat 2D anime illustration, Japanese city pop, flat painted backgrounds
entradas.estilo_palabras: in a bold retro sans-serif font with a magenta neon outline and an amber fill

plan.arco: From playful motion in neon-lit streets to stillness under a starlit sky
plan.look: Night and dusk, warm neon glow, saturated warm palette
